notes.title: What's new in v2.1.1
notes.content:
- We have fixed the issue and crash related to screen recording with computer audio.

Enhancements in Video Editing Timeline:
- Annotations can now be viewed and rearranged more easily on the timeline.
- You can now insert empty space before or between video clips on the timeline, allowing you to easily add annotations or text. This feature is ideal for introducing the next video segment in your sequence.
- Camera video recorded alongside screen captures can now be resized and repositioned within the workbench.
- Additional minor enhancements have also been made.

notes.title: What's New
notes.content:
Additions:
- Capto now supports 3 new languages: Chinese (Simplified), Portuguese (BR), and Japanese.

Fixes & performance improvements:
- We’ve also gotten rid of bugs related to editing of iOS screen recordings that were recorded along with the Mac screen.

notes.title: Capto Update!
notes.content:
What's new?[list]
[*] Fixed a bug related to sharing on YouTube and Google Drive.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused crashes while recording.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused problems in launching Capto Helper in the status menu.
[/list]
That should teach those pesky bugs! :P

We would love your feedback so that we can keep improving Capto for you :)

Cheers!
